Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Coffee Table, 53"W, Antique Natural and Black
Colors: Antique Natural/Black
Materials: Stone
This industrial coffee table touts an iron base in a black powder-coated finish and a natural-antique, solid-wood top and has a contemporary-meets-country flair that looks great with most decor. The sturdy iron base adds durability to the rustic elegance and helps reduce daily wear and tear. 53.15"W x 29.53"D x 15.75"H Solid wood tops an iron base. This casual coffee table with an iron base and a solid wood top in an antique finish looks great with most decor styles. The solid wood top and iron base add durability. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipe with a soft, damp cloth; dry thoroughly. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
